subject: Remediation ownership declaration, CVE SLA table, and DocuSign escrow instructions
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@finservco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finservco.com, procurement@finservco.com
Date: 2027-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: remediation ownership + CVE SLA table for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 review and SIG/CAIQ intake, FinServ needs a short, signed declaration that clarifies:

- Who at Redwood owns remediation for infra-facing CVEs vs. product library CVEs (we need person/team names and escalation contacts).
- Your target SLA buckets for CVE remediation by severity (we typically map to critical/high/medium/low).
- Confirmation that you run authenticated network scans at least weekly and VM scans (full) every 30 days; if not, please provide cadence and compensating controls.

We also need a delegation/escrow instruction if Redwood requires DocuSign for an attestation that an authorized signee (director or above) will sign within 48h of our request during audit windows. If you have a template attestation, please attach it.

Specific ask: can you provide the declaration + a CVE SLA table and identify who will sign? Also include any recent patch manifest for CVE-2027-1234 — FinServ flagged it during triage and wants proof of remediation steps or a timeline.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — ideally in 48 hours. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhou
Security Programs, FinServ Co
emily.zhou@finservco.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: finserv-soc2-evidence-request-20270827.pdf (application/pdf, 230KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@finservco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-28T13:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation ownership + CVE SLA table for SOC 2 evidence

Emily — thanks, received and looping in Laura and Monica who own product security and infra. High level answers below; attaching a short declaration and a draft SLA table for your review.

Summary (high level)
- Infra-facing CVEs (OS, hypervisor, container runtime): Monica Patel (Director, Infrastructure Security) — infra-remediation@redwoodinference.com. Monica will own patch windows and escalation to on-call infra leads.
- Product/library CVEs (model dependencies, app libraries): Laura Bennett (Head of Product Security) — product-security@redwoodinference.com. Laura will handle triage and coordinated rollouts with engineering.
- Scan cadence: Authenticated host scans (weekly), full authenticated VM scans (30 days), and daily container image CVE pipeline (CI-based). We run additional targeted scans during active incident response.
- CVE SLA (draft): Critical = 24 hours (ack + mitigation plan), High = 72 hours (fix/mitigation), Medium = 30 days, Low = next regular release.

We will provide a signed declaration (Director-level) via DocuSign. Attestation will be executed by Monica if the items are infra-related, or by Laura for product/library items. I attached: redwood-vm-ownership-declaration-20270830.pdf and cve-sla-table-20270830.csv.

Regarding CVE-2027-1234: Monica is pulling the patch manifest and test evidence; we expect to have either a completed patch (and manifest) or a remediation schedule within 24 hours. If you require proof-of-patch (binary/checksums), we can provide a manifest plus internal scan exports as an evidence packet.

We can sign the attestation within 48 hours as requested. If DocuSign escrow instructions are required, share the DocuSign envelope or we can initiate from our side — happy to follow your preference.

Proposed next step: a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow 8/29 to confirm scope and finalize the attestation signer.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-vm-ownership-declaration-20270830.pdf (application/pdf, 16KB); cve-sla-table-20270830.csv (text/csv, 3KB)

From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@finservco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finservco.com, procurement@finservco.com
Date: 2027-08-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation ownership + CVE SLA table for SOC 2 evidence

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the attachments. A few follow-ups before we schedule sign-off:

1) Can you provide the CVE SLA as a machine-readable table (we prefer CSV) that maps severity, SLA (hours/days), and responsible owner email per row — we received the CSV but need the severity mapping fields to include "CVE score threshold" (e.g., CVSS >= 9.0 = Critical).

2) For CVE-2027-1234 specifically: FinServ triage noted a public exploit in the wild. We need 
   - current status (patched/in-progress)
   - proof-of-patch (patch manifest or scan output) OR exact timeline for patch and scheduled verification window

3) Please confirm your exception process (if a fix requires a code freeze/rollback risk) — who signs off internal exception approvals and how are compensating controls documented?

DocuSign: If Redwood can create the envelope and route to Monica/Laura, that works fine for us. We will accept the signed attestation and store it in our SOC evidence binder.

If you can get the CSV with CVSS thresholds and either the patch manifest or a firm remediation schedule for CVE-2027-1234 by EOD 8/29, that should keep us on track for our audit window. Otherwise we'll need a short call.

Best,
Emily
